description_en: This document describes the syntax and examples of template video face fusion MergeVideoModelFace
description_zh: 本文介绍模版视频人脸融合MergeVideoModelFace的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun videoenhan merge-video-model-face --template-id 3bf2418c-7adf-4002-a9d6-2f7cf1889c0d --face-image-url http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/videoenhan/MergeVideoFace/MergeVideoFace-xxxx.png --add-watermark true --enhance true --watermark-type EN --merge-infos ImageURL=http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test-team/MergeVideoModelFace/xxx.jpg TemplateFaceID=f913c614-d542-42ba-b173-07db2058c207_0 TemplateFaceURL=http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-/videoenhan/MergeVideoModelFace/xxx.jpg --region cn-hangzhou
name: MergeVideoModelFace

parameters.help_en: The template ID of the video face template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the reference face image for replacement (cannot be empty when TemplateId is for a single face). **FaceImageURL** is only used for single-person video scenarios, and there is no need to input the **MergeInfos** field.
Currently, only OSS links in the Shanghai region are supported. For how to generate a URL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

Input limits:
- Image format: JPEG, JPG, PNG.
- Image resolution: Greater than or equal to 128×128 pixels, less than or equal to 4000×4000 pixels.
- Image size: No larger than 20 MB.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
替换后的人脸参考图像URL地址（TemplateId为单人脸时不可为空）。**FaceImageURL**仅为单人视频场景时使用，此时无需输入**MergeInfos**字段。
当前仅支持上海地域的OSS链接，如何生成URL请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

输入限制：
- 图像格式：JPEG、JPG、PNG。
- 图像分辨率：大于等于128×128像素，小于等于4000×4000像素。
- 图像大小：不大于20 MB。
- URL地址不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: face_image_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add a watermark. Valid values:

- True (default): Add a watermark.
- False: Do not add a watermark
parameters.help_zh:
是否添加水印。取值范围如下：

- True（默认）：添加水印。
- False：不添加水印
parameters.name: add_watermark

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable face beauty enhancement. Valid values:

- False (default): Disable face beauty enhancement.
- True: Enable face beauty enhancement
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启人脸美颜增强。取值范围如下：

- False（默认）：不开启人脸美颜增强。
- True：开启人脸美颜增强
parameters.name: enhance

parameters.help_en:
The watermark type. Valid values:

- EN (default): English watermark.
- CN: Chinese watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印类型。取值范围如下：

- EN（默认）：英文水印。
- CN：中文水印
parameters.name: watermark_type

element_fields.help_en:
The sub-ID of a specific face in the multi-face template. You need to obtain this from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468904.html API first (when passing in multiple TemplateFaceID values, they cannot be duplicated).

> When both **TemplateFaceID** and **TemplateFaceURL** are passed in, **TemplateFaceID** takes priority
element_fields.help_zh:
多脸模板对应的某个人脸的子ID。需要先在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468904.html接口中获取（传入多个TemplateFaceID时，不可重复）。

> 同时传入**TemplateFaceID**和**TemplateFaceURL**时，**TemplateFaceID**优先
element_fields.name: template_face_id

element_fields.help_en: The image URL of a specific face in the multi-face template. This allows users to use third-party detection modules to extract frames for face recognition and obtain the corresponding face images
element_fields.help_zh: 多脸模板对应的某个人脸的图像URL。此情况允许用户自己使用第三方检测模块抽帧进行人脸识别后获取相应的人脸图像
element_fields.name: template_face_url

element_fields.help_en: The image URL of the face to be replaced. Currently, only OSS links in the Shanghai region are supported. For how to generate a URL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
element_fields.help_zh: 该人脸待替换的图像URL。当前仅支持上海地域的OSS链接，如何生成URL请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
element_fields.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The merge parameters, including the face information of the template video and the user face images to be merged (cannot be empty when TemplateId is for multiple faces).

> - **MergeInfos** is only used for multi-person video scenarios. Make sure that the **VideoScene** parameter was set to `multi` when the user added the template. The **TemplateFaceID** values passed in must correspond one-to-one with the **TemplateFaceID** values in the **FaceInfos** returned when the template was added.
- If both **FaceImageURL** and **MergeInfos** are passed in, the one used depends on whether the **TemplateId** is for a single or multiple faces. The other input parameter is filtered out
parameters.help_zh:
融合参数，模板视频的人脸信息及待融合的用户人脸图片（TemplateId为多人脸时不可为空）。

> - **MergeInfos**仅为多人视频场景时使用，需确保用户添加模板时**VideoScene**参数传入了`multi`值，其中传入的**TemplateFaceID**需要与添加模版时返回的**FaceInfos**里的**TemplateFaceID**一一对应。
- 同时传入**FaceImageURL**和**MergeInfos**，以**TemplateId**为单/多人脸为准，过滤另一个入参
parameters.name: merge_infos
